headline.before: After the round: is execution still moving

subheadline: Turn obstacles into opportunities with an expert who understands your journey. Team up with me!

cards.title: Is post-round execution stalling?
cards.description: Funding closed, but priorities blur, the roadmap slips, and weeks go by without real shipping.
cards.solution: Get a clear product and tech plan so the team ships what matters — not everything.

cards.title: Is your tech slowing development — not users?
cards.description: The product is live, but the codebase and ways of working make every feature slower and riskier than it should be.
cards.solution: Fix what blocks delivery: architecture, process, and engineering practices that scale how you build.

cards.title: Missing a strong CTO — or is the one you have stretched thin?
cards.description: Leadership gaps show up as slow decisions, weak hiring, and a team that can’t keep the pace the business needs.
cards.solution: I step in on product, tech, and team — leading, and hands-on when it unlocks speed.
